title: Corporate Policy
description: Find the next valid password by incrementing through corporate policy rules.
writeup:
## Approach

Work with the password as a list of integers (0–25) and increment like a base-26 counter. The key optimization is skipping past forbidden letters (`i`, `o`, `l`): when one is found, increment it and zero out everything to the right, since no valid password can contain those letters.

## Part 1

Increment the input password until all three rules are satisfied: contains an increasing straight of three consecutive letters, no forbidden letters, and at least two distinct non-overlapping pairs.

## Part 2

Increment the Part 1 answer one more time and find the next valid password. Same logic, just applied twice.
